# SH Auto Parts

> SH AUTO PARTS PTE. LTD., Singapore (UEN 202418610M). Sells China and EV car parts, mainly body parts, to workshops and car owners in Singapore. No export. Tagline: China Car Parts Supplier.

## Facts
- Legal name: SH AUTO PARTS PTE. LTD.
- UEN: 202418610M
- Registered: 9 May 2024 (live company)
- Registered address: 61 Woodlands Industrial Park E9, #01-08, E9 Premium, Singapore 757047
- Activity: retail sale of spare parts and accessories for motor vehicles (SSIC 47314)
- Phone: +65 8368 0055, +65 8368 1155 (WhatsApp +65 8368 0055)
- Email: shautopartspl@gmail.com
- Opening hours, prices, stock, warranty: to confirm (not published)
